item.title: CircuitPython RV565 — via awesome-circuitpython
item.description: Play video clips on CircuitPython displays: RV565 stores each frame as zlib-compressed RGB565, so playback is inflate and blit, through displayio or straight to an ST7789 (16.5 FPS on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2).

item.title: CircuitPython Pin Audit — via awesome-circuitpython
item.description: An early static checker for potential pin allocation conflicts, with explicit resource lifetime tracking and JSON/GitHub Actions output; runs on a desktop without executing firmware.
